name: maggy-assistant/magento2-base
description: AI-powered admin assistant for Magento 2. Chat with your store using Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama and more.

suggest.maggy-assistant/magento2-issue-tracker: Add-on for reporting issues to GitHub, Jira, and other project trackers
suggest.symfony/ai-anthropic-platform: Required to run the assistant on Anthropic
suggest.symfony/ai-azure-platform: Required to run the assistant on Azure OpenAI
suggest.symfony/ai-deep-seek-platform: Required to run the assistant on DeepSeek
suggest.symfony/ai-gemini-platform: Required to run the assistant on Google Gemini
suggest.symfony/ai-hugging-face-platform: Required to run the assistant on Hugging Face
suggest.symfony/ai-lm-studio-platform: Required to run the assistant on a local LM Studio instance
suggest.symfony/ai-ollama-platform: Required to run the assistant on a local Ollama instance
suggest.symfony/ai-open-ai-platform: Required to run the assistant on OpenAI
suggest.symfony/ai-open-router-platform: Required to run the assistant on OpenRouter
